data.name: Active skills
data.description: Each hero can equip up to 3 active skills. Their conditions trigger them automatically.
data.status: Community-reference checked

data.name: Squad slots
data.description: A squad can contain up to 3 heroes; Formation Engravings unlock the additional slots.
data.status: Community-reference checked

data.name: Gear rarities
data.description: Common → Uncommon → Rare → Unique → Epic → Legendary → Immortal → Ascendant → Primordial → Mythic.
data.status: Community-reference checked

data.name: Fusion
data.description: The Workshop consumes 9 equipment pieces to produce one result, with odds depending on the recipe.
data.status: Community-reference checked

data.name: Market trading
data.description: Legendary-or-higher equipment can be eligible for transfer to Steam Inventory and Community Market trading, subject to current game and Steam restrictions.
data.status: Community-reference checked

data.name: Pet bonuses
data.description: Owned pets provide party bonuses even when not currently following the squad.
data.status: Community-reference checked

data.name: Chest drops
data.description: Kills can roll for chest drops; the stage, enemy type and Engraving bonuses affect the result. Exact odds are stage-specific.
data.status: Community-reference checked

data.name: Boss stages
data.description: The tenth stage of each chapter is a boss stage. There are four difficulties and four chapters per difficulty. A boss stage needs a map, which the ninth stage gives on its first clear.
data.status: Community-reference checked

data.name: Offline rewards
data.description: Offline progression exists, but actual reward amounts depend on current game rules, stage and upgrades; no unsupported estimate is displayed here.
data.status: Community-reference checked
